tests.stimulus: Use the fixed eight-warp,four-thread configuration and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Assert and release asynchronous reset and establish nonzero bank/result state only through accepted operations or dispatch edges. Initialize writable scratch CSRs and dispatch/base fields, then reset at startup, while holding a stalled result, and with a short pulse entirely between rising edges. Read back previously nonzero scratch state after the short pulse. Issue a vector or mstatus/vtype read on the first released edge and repeat after it.
tests.expected: All reset-cleared state and result payloads become zero asynchronously; no short pulse is missed. First-edge reads see zero MPP/vtype/capacity, and later reads see MPP0x1800, vtype0x10 and vector capacity4.
tests.checker: An independent self-contained native model predicts an abstract addressed bank map and retained result entry from input history only; no DUT output enters prediction. Separate actual and predicted wires feed four-state comparisons1ns after rising clk, asynchronous reset and any query-selector change after settling. Any difference emits UVM_ERROR; finite stimulus and mandatory sample/reset counts reject vacuity.

tests.stimulus: Use the fixed eight-warp,four-thread configuration and known binary inputs stable around rising edges.
